items.text: Ma e wach Jehova Nyasaye mane obirone janabi Jeremia kuom ogendini:
Ma e ote ne jolwenj Farao Neko ruodh Misri, mane oloo Karkemish e Aora mar Yufrate gi Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon e higa mar angʼwen mar Jehoyakim wuod Josia ruodh Juda:
Kawuru kereu kurwako oguteu mag lweny!
kendo giringo ka gia kar lweny
nikech thuondi mag-gi mag lweny oselo.
Giringo ka luoro omakogi ma ok gingʼi ngʼegi,
kendo gin-gi luoro malich koni gi koni,"
kata joma otegno ok nyal tony.
E yo nyandwat but Aora Yufrate
"Ma en ngʼa magingore ka aora Nael
kendo mana ka aore ma pigegi bubni?
kendo mana ka aore ma pigegi bubni.
Owacho ni, 'Abiro gingora kendo anapongʼ piny;
anaketh mier madongo kod ji modakie.'
Yaye, un joriemb geche, riembgiuru matek!
yaye un jolweny machwo moa Kush,
kaachiel gi chwo Lidia maywayo atungʼ.
Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ma en odiechiengʼ,
Ligangla noneki nyaka owinj ni orome,
kendo nyaka otiek riyo mare gi remo.
nochiw misango e piny mantie yo
kendo imany yath, yaye Nyar Misri Mangili.
To kata obedo ni imedo manyo yedhe
to imenyo kayiem kendo ok inichangi.
Jolweny nochwanyre kuom moro ka moro;
Ma e ote mane Jehova Nyasaye owachone Jeremia janabi kuom biro Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon mondo omonj Misri:
mabor gi ligangla mar joma thiro ji.'
'Farao ruodh Misri en mana jakoko matek,
ngʼato achiel nobi machalo gi Tabor e dier gode,
kata ka Got Karmel mantie but nam.
kendo tieke chuth maonge ngʼama nodagie."
to kalabugo birone koa yo nyandwat.
Jolweny mondiki chal gi nyiroye machwe.
Gin bende ginilokre kendo giring kanyakla,
nimar odiechiengʼ mar masira biro kuomgi,
ka jasigu masudo machiegni gi teko;
Gingʼeny moloyo dede, ok nyal kwan-gi.
kendo nochiwe ne jogo moa yo nyandwat."
Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel, wacho niya, "Achiegni kelo kum kuom Amon ma nyasach Thebes, kuom Farao, kuom Misri gi nyisechene kod ruodhi mage, kod jogo mogeno kuom Farao.
Anachiwgi ne jogo madwaro ngimagi, ne Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon gi jotende. To kata kamano ji nodhi nyime dak Misri kaka chon," Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
Adiera abiro resi e piny mabor,
Kik iluor, yaye Jakobo jatichna, nimar an kodi.
Anakumu to mana gi bura makare;
ok anaweu ngangʼ ma ok akumou,"
